I can see the issue! The storefront-web 3.0 pods are failing to connect to the OpenTelemetry collector at `otel-collector.observability.svc:4317`. The error is `ECONNREFUSED`, which means the connection is being refused. The application is starting and the health checks are passing, but the OpenTelemetry export is failing and the export queue is filling up.
